entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi, Sarah. I'm calling about my VeloBand GPS Tracker. I'm... I'm just so disappointed with it. The pulse reader is completely off.
Oh, I'm very sorry to hear you're having trouble. To make sure I understand correctly, is it a technical fault with the sensor, or a preference issue with how it displays the data?
It's a fault. It's saying my heart rate is 150 when I'm just sitting on the couch. It's basically just a piece of plastic garbage on my wrist. I was so excited for this, and it just doesn't work.

I can certainly understand why that would be frustrating. It sounds like a sensor calibration issue. I can walk you through a quick factory reset which usually resolves this right away. Do you have a moment to try that with me?

Honestly, I just don't have time to be a technician for a brand new device. This was supposed to make things easier. I've been a loyal customer for years and I've never had a problem like this. I don't want to fix it, I just want my money back for a full refund.
I understand your position. You want a product that works perfectly right out of the box, and troubleshooting can be a hassle.
Exactly. I really needed this to work, and now I just want the money back. I don't mean to be difficult, but I feel like I was sold a faulty product.

Not at all, I completely understand. And I want to thank you for your loyalty to VeloFit. Let me pull up your account and review our return options for you. Can you please confirm the email address on your account?
Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see your order here. I'm just checking our official return policy. It looks like you received the VeloBand 43 days ago.
Yes, that sounds about right. Is that going to be a problem?
Not at all. I've just confirmed that our policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery. You are well within that window, so I can absolutely process this return for you immediately.
Oh, really? That's... a huge relief. Thank you so much, Sarah. I was so worried I'd be stuck with it. You've been a great help.

You are very welcome. It's my pleasure to get this sorted out for you. As you're a VIP member with us, I've also added a 20% discount coupon to your account as an apology for the trouble. I'm sending the pre-paid return label to your email now. Once we receive the item, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method. Is there anything else I can do for you?
No, that's perfect. That's more than I expected. Thank you again for everything.
You're most welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
